series.definition: Native USDA NASS Quick Stats PRODUCTION; source program SURVEY. CORN, GRAIN - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU. Source class, production/utilization practice, native unit and reference period are separate series dimensions.
series.reporting_period: Publisher YEAR label and YEAR reference period; crop/marketing/inventory calendars remain distinct.

native_source_dimensions.SHORT_DESC: CORN, GRAIN - PRODUCTION, MEASURED IN BU

series.source_cv_definition: Original CV_% retained separately; blank or NUL is not zero; H/L are source precision-bound symbols, not measurement values.

sources.title: USDA NASS Quick Stats crops public bulk snapshot,30October2026

limitations: Survey estimates and Census reported/adjusted statistics are separate series; neither is an error-free direct count.
Suppressed, unavailable and precision-limited source cells remain nonnumeric; (Z) and (Y) are not converted to zero.
Coverage varies by place, commodity, source program and year. Census observations are actual report years, not interpolated annual estimates.
Overlapping classes, practices, units and total/component products must not be added as independent output.

COUNTY source combined/other geographies remain in the ledger but are excluded from model eligibility; exact historical county FIPS without current outlines remain measurements with mapping missingness.
Map boundaries do not reconstruct historical counties. No name/proximity join or current-boundary back-allocation is made.
Native YEAR can be a crop/reporting-year or season-ending label. Current and forward annual figures may be forecasts or preliminary; revisions remain publisher snapshots.

source_value_flag_dictionary.(D): withheld to avoid disclosing individual operations
source_value_flag_dictionary.(Z): less than half the unit shown; not a numeric zero
source_value_flag_dictionary.(Y): less than level of precision shown; not a numeric zero

series.native_source_record_basis: 1-based logical tab-delimited record number, including the header as record1; exact39sourcefields retained in original gzip.
